known_limitations: The local server lifecycle uses a PID file under runtime/steward and is intended for a single local operator process, not multi-host orchestration.

The start command launches the existing Steward command center server as a local subprocess; if the Python environment cannot import the local package, startup reports unreachable and points operators to the log file.
Optional dashboard/source artifacts may be unavailable; the Operations Center reports those as degraded/missing rather than failing startup.

summary: Implemented a local-first Operations Center server bootstrap command surface for start, status, and stop.
The bootstrap wraps the existing Steward command center implementation instead of creating a second Operations Center UI.
Startup loads local settings, runs service health preflight, generates the static command center entry point, reports degraded/missing optional components, and writes a local PID/log path.
Status and shutdown are local-only and preserve command authority: no work packages are executed, no secrets are stored, and Steward authorization/recall semantics are not bypassed.
Registered WP-0097 in the validation framework with required and observational checks.
